Project.title: Project
Project.description: A software application or utility created by MonoVoice.

id.description: Unique stable identifier for the application (e.g., monovoice, quicknotes).

featured.description: Whether the app is pinned to the homepage showcase.

download.description: Platform-specific binary download URLs and filenames.

screenshots.description: List of screenshot preview objects with localized captions.

changelog.description: Historical release versions and change bullet points.

updatedAt.description: Last update timestamp in ISO-8601 format.

UploadedFileMeta.title: UploadedFileMeta
UploadedFileMeta.description: Metadata for files managed on the server or in storage.

id.description: Unique identifier for the file metadata record.

mimeType.description: MIME type of the uploaded file.

uploadedAt.description: Timestamp of upload in ISO-8601 format.

url.description: Access URL for downloading or viewing the file.

usageLocation.description: Where the file is referenced (e.g. Screenshot, Binary Download).

isPrivate.description: Whether the file requires admin authentication to access.

AdminAuditLog.title: AdminAuditLog
AdminAuditLog.description: Security audit record for administrative actions.

action.description: Action type identifier (e.g., LOGIN, PROJECT_UPDATE, FILE_DELETE).

BackupManifest.title: BackupManifest
BackupManifest.description: Metadata and checksum manifest for a system backup.

sizeBytes.description: Size of the backup archive in bytes.

checksumSha256.description: Cryptographic SHA-256 hash of the backup archive.

projectCount.description: Number of projects included in the backup.

storagePath.description: Private Cloud Storage path to archive.

isVerified.description: Whether the backup checksum was verified.

hasInlineSnapshot.description: Whether an inline JSON snapshot is attached.

RecoveryOperationLog.title: RecoveryOperationLog
RecoveryOperationLog.description: State tracking for chunked backup recovery operations.

backupId.description: ID of the backup being restored.

preRestoreSnapshotId.description: Emergency snapshot ID created prior to restoration.

lastSuccessfulChunkIndex.description: Index of the last successfully committed batch.

status.description: Current status of the recovery operation.

SystemSettings.title: SystemSettings
SystemSettings.description: Global application configuration and migration lock state.

seed_completed.description: Flag indicating initial seed data was committed.

lockedBy.description: Container revision or instance ID that holds the migration lock.

lockedAt.description: Timestamp when the lock was acquired.

autoBackupEnabled.description: Whether automated scheduled backups are enabled.

autoBackupIntervalHours.description: Interval between automatic backups in hours.

RateLimitRecord.title: RateLimitRecord
RateLimitRecord.description: Distributed rate limiting counter per client IP hash.

SudoToken.title: SudoToken
SudoToken.description: Single-use short-lived authorization token for destructive actions.

/projects/{projectId}.description: Primary storage of application project entries.

/uploaded_files/{fileId}.description: Registry of uploaded asset and binary metadata.

/backups/{backupId}.description: Registry of system backup manifests and verification hashes.

/recovery_operation_log/{operationId}.description: Operational checkpoint records for multi-batch restore operations.

/system_settings/{settingKey}.description: System settings, distributed migration locks, and scheduler configuration.

/rate_limits/{limitKey}.description: Multi-instance shared IP login attempt rate limits.

/sudo_tokens/{tokenId}.description: Multi-instance single-use confirmation tokens for high-risk operations.

/admin_devices/{deviceId}.description: Registered trusted Android authenticator devices with ECDSA P-256 public keys.

/admin_pairing_codes/{codeId}.description: Temporary 6-digit one-time codes for enrolling trusted devices with brute-force protection.

/admin_approval_requests/{requestId}.description: Cryptographic approval challenges for sensitive operations with idempotency state machine.

/admin_device_challenges/{challengeId}.description: Ephemeral single-use challenges for mutual authentication of phone HTTP requests.

/admin_recovery_codes/{codeHash}.description: Single-use emergency recovery codes exclusively for revoking compromised or lost devices.
